inputBoundary.rule: Only accepted public curated record blobs are aligned. Native OFF, USDA and Open Prices downloads remain local evidence. Withheld records, contributor identities, proof images/IDs and prohibited raw fields are not promoted.

mappingPolicy: All output identities are source-scoped and names/labels retain cited source text. Source strings that are codes, units, identifiers, dates or IRIs remain fixed typed values. Each nutrient observation keeps its own source basis; original metric key, definition, qualifier, method and source-specific metadata are retained in a named cited structure assertion. No product, barcode, food, nutrient, retailer, country, origin, ingredient or dietary equivalence is inferred across sources.
